purpose: Define the minimum pre-calibration contract required before the Human Infra life-path toy model can be upgraded into a calibrated predictive model. This file is a readiness checklist, not a validated model specification.

currentBoundary.summary: The current model is executable and audited, but it is not fitted, calibrated, validated, or usable for individual decision making.

standards.role: Transparent reporting fields for clinical prediction models, including model purpose, data source, predictors, outcome definition, validation and limitations.
standards.localUseBoundary: Used only as a reporting checklist anchor; does not imply the toy model satisfies TRIPOD+AI.

standards.role: Risk-of-bias and applicability review for prediction model studies.
standards.localUseBoundary: Used only to define future bias/applicability checks; no PROBAST assessment is possible without a real study design and data.

standards.role: Model structure, parameter, validation, uncertainty and reporting practice anchor.
standards.localUseBoundary: Used only to shape audit fields; does not make the model a decision model or cost-effectiveness model.

standards.role: Complex intervention development, evaluation, implementation and context anchor.
standards.localUseBoundary: Used only to keep Human Infra interventions context-aware; does not evaluate any specific intervention.

standards.role: Engineering language for target cohort, outcome cohort, time-at-risk, covariates and validation.
standards.localUseBoundary: Used only as an implementation pattern; no OHDSI dataset or package run is claimed.

targetPopulation.definition: A cohort-level Human Infra study population must be explicitly defined before calibration, including age range, geography, observation window, inclusion criteria, exclusion criteria and data provenance.
targetPopulation.currentPlaceholder: Synthetic cohort age 40-120 only; no real population.

timeZero.definition: The index date at which predictors are frozen and follow-up begins.
timeZero.currentPlaceholder: Toy model starts at synthetic age 40; no index date in real calendar time.

predictionHorizons.boundary: Lifetime-scenario outputs must remain cohort-level and must not be converted into individual death dates.

primary.name: survivalProbability
primary.definition: Cohort-level probability of remaining alive beyond a horizon.

primary.name: healthQualityIntegral
primary.definition: Area under survival weighted by health-quality proxy.

primary.name: effectiveTime
primary.definition: Synthetic proxy for usable action time, combining survival, health quality and capability multiplier.

secondary.name: futureOptionValue
secondary.definition: Scenario-level proxy for future choice space, not a welfare claim.

secondary.name: levThresholdStatus
secondary.definition: Whether annual life-extension progress crosses the open-boundary threshold in the toy model.

minimumEstimands.label: Cohort survival distribution shift
minimumEstimands.question: How does a scenario-level intervention bundle shift the cohort survival curve relative to baseline?

minimumEstimands.label: Effective time gain
minimumEstimands.question: How does a scenario-level intervention bundle change health-quality-weighted usable action time?

minimumEstimands.label: Future option value proxy
minimumEstimands.question: How does a scenario-level intervention bundle change modeled future choice-space proxy values?

estimands.boundary: These are scenario-level estimands; they are not individual treatment effects.

candidatePredictors.boundary: No predictor is active until its measurement source, missingness, governance basis and calibration status are recorded.

dataRequirements.missingDataStatement: No real cohort, endpoint follow-up, calibration dataset, or external validation dataset is currently present.
dataRequirements.minimumBeforeCalibration: At least one governed longitudinal cohort with mortality and functional outcomes plus a held-out validation plan.

publicAggregateMortalityAnchor.sourceAuthority: National Center for Health Statistics, National Vital Statistics System
publicAggregateMortalityAnchor.scope: United States sex-specific public aggregate period life tables, ages 40-100.
allowedUses: aggregate mortality scale anchoring before real cohort calibration
publicAggregateMortalityAnchor.boundary: This public aggregate anchor improves the mortality baseline reference layer, but it does not satisfy real cohort access, field confirmation, censoring, survey design, calibration, external validation or individual-use gates.

publicLinkedMortalityAggregatePilot.sourceAuthority: CDC/NCHS public-use NHANES Linked Mortality File
publicLinkedMortalityAggregatePilot.scope: NHANES 2017-2018 public-use eligible adults joined to the 2019 public-use Linked Mortality File and aggregated by sex and age band.
allowedUses: public real-data aggregate pipeline smoke test
SEQN join and fixed-width LMF parser contract test
publicLinkedMortalityAggregatePilot.boundary: This public linked-mortality aggregate pilot proves only that one official public NHANES-LMF path can be downloaded, joined in a temporary workspace and exported as coarse aggregate cells. It does not satisfy NHATS access, field/value confirmation, survey-design variance, external validation, calibration, intervention effects or individual-use gates.

publicLinkedMortalitySurveyDesignReadine.sourceAuthority: CDC/NCHS NHANES public-use DEMO_J plus public-use Linked Mortality File
publicLinkedMortalitySurveyDesignReadine.scope: NHANES 2017-2018 DEMO_J documents WTMEC2YR, SDMVPSU and SDMVSTRA for the public-use aggregate pilot context.
publicLinkedMortalitySurveyDesignReadine.boundary: This readiness contract records official NHANES public-use design fields and keeps WTMEC2YR/SDMVPSU/SDMVSTRA as diagnostic readiness evidence only. It does not implement a weighted estimator, survey variance, domain rule, disclosure-reviewed public output, external validation, calibration or individual-use model.

censoringAndCompetingRisks.boundary: The toy model does not model censoring or competing risks.

validationPlan.boundary: No validation result may be claimed until a real development cohort and validation cohort exist.

calibrationPlan.boundary: Calibration diagnostics are planned fields only; the toy model cannot produce real calibration metrics.

sensitivityAnalysisPlan.boundary: Sensitivity analysis is mandatory before any claim that a scenario ordering is stable.

biasAndApplicabilityPlan.boundary: Any real model must report where it does not apply and which groups are likely underrepresented.

reportingPlan.boundary: A Web visualization is not sufficient evidence without these report artifacts.

prohibitedUses: No insurance, employment, credit, eligibility, or coercive scoring.
No claim of clinical validity, causal validity, or personal usefulness from toy outputs.
No conversion of LEV open-boundary states into infinite personal lifespan claims.

minimumRequirements: validation split or external validation source
